title: FIGHT GONE BAD · GAUNTLET EDITION
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 stations × 1:00 max reps, a flat leg out of every one, 3 rounds, score = total reps
why: Upper pull + press volume on tired-but-not-sore legs, with a weighted sit-up station scored like every other lift. Every rep is a point; the run legs are the toll.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A — shoulders / spine / wrists

blocks.title: FIGHT GONE BAD · 3 ROUNDS · 5 STATIONS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · 1:00 max reps per station · 0.10 mi leg out of every station · cap 30:00 · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · 35 lb · 1.5 mi
blocks.format: One clock. 1:00 max reps at the station, run the leg, straight into the next station. Count every rep. Score = total reps across all 3 rounds.
blocks.workRest: Leg 0.10 mi @ 8.5 flat after every station, all 3 rounds. No rest minute — the leg is the rest.

items.name: S1 · Double push press 2×40 lb · 1:00 max
items.detail: rack once, drive with the legs, lock out every rep

items.name: S2 · Double bent-over row 2×40 lb · 1:00 max
items.detail: bells to the ribs, pause at the top

items.name: S3 · CORE · Weighted sit-up 35 lb · 1:00 max
items.detail: bell hugged to the chest, shoulders to the floor every rep

items.name: S4 · Sumo deadlift high pull 50 lb · 1:00 max
items.detail: elbows above the bell at the top

items.name: S5 · Burpee · 1:00 max
items.detail: chest to the floor, jump and clap at the top

items.name: STRETCH · if under 30:00 · S3 + S5 one more minute each

blocks.noteGreen: Log the total score, the station that scored lowest, and RPE. Over 250 is the target; over 300 is the stretch.
blocks.text: Scoring: 1 rep = 1 point at every station. Run legs are not scored.
